Ana Chen: Morning — quick async check-in. What I did: finalized hero copy for the Benchmarks post and uploaded assets to s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/v2. Blockers: need ENG to confirm banner height and CDN path, Product wants A/B variant IDs. Today: coordinate launch assets, schedule post for 10:30 PST, QA on staging.
Samir Patel: Looks good — I made one micro tweak to H2 (voice). Uploaded screenshot_02.png to the bucket. @Michael O'Leary can you confirm banner height and redirect rule for /benchmarks?
Michael O'Leary: Pinged eng-runtime, they'll validate banner constraints and responsive crop. ETA ~1h. Also FYI prefer CDN path /static/marketing/benchmarks/ — will confirm exact prefix.
Tori Nguyen: Blocked on hero GIF render — Lina mentioned render queue earlier. @Lina (intern) any update? If still queued I can swap to static jpg for the launch.
Lina (intern): Render finished ~10m ago, uploading now. Will paste the public URL when available.
Benchmarks Bot: Draft queued: benchmarks-2026-q1 (ID 789) — reviewer needed. Preview: https://redwood-internal/benchmarks/drafts/789
Ana Chen: Two asks: (1) ENG please add redirect rule before 10:15 PST or we'll miss scheduled publish; (2) Growth: please approve UTM params: ?utm_source=bench-launch&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=2026-q1-bench
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: UTM params approved from growth side.
Michael O'Leary: Redirect rule added and CDN path confirmed. Did a quick smoke test on staging — images served gzipped and cache-control looks good.
Lina (intern): Upload complete: s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/gif_hero_v3.gif (public: https://cdn.redwood.com/static/marketing/benchmarks/gif_hero_v3.gif)
Tori Nguyen: QA plan: visual diff at 9:45, check mobile crop (iPhone SE) and hero alignment on 1366x768. If anything weird I'll drop screenshots here.
Ana Chen: Awesome. If anything blocks before 10:15 ping #eng-oncall. If all green I'll publish at 10:30 and spin up the launch thread here with links to analytics snapshots. Thanks everyone — quick and lean today!
